tools.name: ide_gateway_start
tools.title: Start IDE Gateway endpoint
tools.description: Start a local full OpenAI-compatible API gateway endpoint for the active MCP model to serve IDE requests. Exposes /v1/chat/completions (stream + non-stream), /v1/responses, /v1/models, /v1/files, /v1/images/generations, /v1/images/edits, /v1/audio/speech, /v1/audio/transcriptions, /v1/audio/translations, /v1/embeddings, /v1/moderations, /v1/tools.

tools.name: ide_gateway_stop
tools.title: Stop IDE Gateway endpoint
tools.description: Stop a running local IDE Gateway endpoint.

tools.name: ide_gateway_status
tools.title: IDE Gateway status
tools.description: Show running status and queue status for IDE Gateway endpoints.

tools.name: ide_gateway_show_config
tools.title: Show IDE Gateway connection config
tools.description: Return copy-paste-ready OpenAI-compatible provider settings for an IDE.

tools.name: ide_gateway_wait_request
tools.title: Wait for IDE request
tools.description: Block until the local IDE Gateway receives an OpenAI-compatible request (chat/completions, responses, images/generations, audio/speech, etc.), then return the normalized request to the active MCP model. The model must process it using MCP tools and call ide_gateway_send_response or ide_gateway_fail_request.

tools.name: ide_gateway_send_response
tools.title: Send IDE response
tools.description: Complete a pending IDE request with an assistant response. Accepts a plain content string for chat/responses/audio-transcription requests, or a structured OpenAI-shaped payload (object) for images/embeddings/moderations where the gateway must serialize specific fields. Pass finish_reason to control the chat/responses finish marker.

tools.name: ide_gateway_fail_request
tools.title: Fail IDE request
tools.description: Complete a pending IDE request with an error.

tools.name: ide_gateway_get_logs
tools.title: Read IDE Gateway logs
tools.description: Read recent redacted logs for a local IDE Gateway endpoint.

tools.name: ide_gateway_rotate_token
tools.title: Rotate IDE Gateway token
tools.description: Generate a new local API token for an IDE Gateway endpoint.

tools.name: ide_gateway_bridge_prompt
tools.title: Show IDE Gateway bridge system-prompt
tools.description: Return a copy-paste system-prompt snippet that turns the active MCP model into a persistent long-poll bridge serving IDE requests without manual pings or chat summaries. This is the canonical way to keep the IDE<->model bridge alive.
